ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity dark pixels (~85%) with high-intensity white linear and mottled pixel clusters (~15%) creating a high-contrast ratio across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive network of white linear streaks concentrated in the medial regions of both lobes; white pixel mottling is localized at the distal tips and along discrete sections of the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees, extending into a narrow vertical fissure towards the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern characterized by moderate-amplitude peaks on the left lobe and higher frequency, lower amplitude serrations on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoid curvature along the outer edges; initial concavity near the notch transitioning to a convex sweep through the mid-lobe, terminating in tapered, upturned tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular white pixel aggregates (rosettes) visible on the distal ends of both lobes and near the central notch area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of intersecting, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths and orientations covering a significant portion of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy accumulation of linear scarring (rake marks) consistent across the entire visible ventral area; minor irregular notch on the distal edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, semi-circular white linear mark (approx. 180-degree arc) located on the lower right lobe quadrant.
